command_arguments.defaults: Plan and datasets package root resolve beside the helper. Local checkpoints resolve from original selected-step filenames inside the supplied results tree.
command_arguments.mirror_constraints: Supply both explicit checkpoint paths or one checkpoints-root, never both layouts. All mirrored containers must match selected byte size and SHA, not only tensors.
command_arguments.result_relocation: Selection/barrier/panel receipts may reside in the supplied result tree while their unchanged historical metadata paths remain authenticated. Source cohort files must still resolve at their exact pinned paths.

expected_outputs.comparison: exact complete saved dictionaries including objective metadata, logits, raw pointers/status/wires/proposals

limitations: Preparation is not a passing replay; root must review and execute under its existing resource owner. No reservation,resource admission,hardware quota or measured RSS is supplied by this helper.
Python socket guards and offline flags are process-level controls,not a kernel network namespace or whole-process syscall sandbox.
Exact HF mirror use still requires original local plan/result/source-input/expected-output assets and matching producer/Torch pins; this is not a self-contained Hub runtime.

Replay authenticates saved identities and runtime reproducibility,not fresh evaluation,reviewed law semantics,native latent conditioning,logic/Lake admission,checkpoint default promotion or original barrier chronology.
reference_access: Plan/result/selection metadata and full saved output panels are read. No TRAIN/selection/final/retention target-reference JSON files are opened, no scoring or reselection occurs.
required_transport: Checkpoint configuration/profile checks and original zero-authority occurrence transport validation remain available; they are required to restore and reproduce the saved proposals and confer no semantic authority.
runtime_guards: CPU only,CUDA visibility empty,Torch2threads/one interop thread,deterministic algorithms
standard HF/Transformers/datasets offline environment; Python socket connect/datagram and DNS entrypoints denied before numerical imports
restore CPU RNG preserved; exact new gate/fullAdam/counters roundtrip before and after prediction
all model/parent tensors,modes,parameter flags,empty gradients,complete nested parent artifact bytes and CPU RNG unchanged
TRAIN example/label/fit/optimizer helpers,online teacher and hinge functions,selection schema/reselection helpers and all semantic parser module callables denied during prediction
backward/autograd and AdamW step/zero_grad denied during prediction; CUDA transfer/init entrypoints denied
every row source digest checked; source input,selected receipt/container,expected panel,barrier,results/plan/helper and producer identities checked for drift
exclusive receipt creation with file and parent-directory fsync; no weight/result-panel writes
